trust_decision.summary: MongoDBSaver decides which tenant's checkpoints a call may touch by putting caller-supplied config.configurable thread_id/checkpoint_ns/checkpoint_id directly into MongoDB query filters, with no check that each one is a string rather than an operator object; this happens in libs/checkpoint-mongodb/src/checkpoint.ts.

landing_point.why: The summary names MongoDBSaver and cross-tenant state access, so a reader opens the saver's getTuple read path first.

fix_sites.entry_point: MongoDBSaver.getTuple(config) (public API; also reached via graph.getState/invoke with a checkpointer)
MongoDBSaver.list(config, {before}) before.configurable.checkpoint_id (public API; second config object)
MongoDBSaver.put(config, ...) parent_checkpoint_id stored into the document (later read back as parentConfig)
MongoDBSaver.deleteThread(threadId) (raw string argument, not a config)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All fix sites are methods of one class in libs/checkpoint-mongodb/src/checkpoint.ts. The closest thing to an odd site is list()'s second config object, options.before (libs/checkpoint-mongodb/src/checkpoint.ts:182-184), and deleteThread's raw-string argument (libs/checkpoint-mongodb/src/checkpoint.ts:335).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the MongoDBStore routes: the advisory names MongoDBSaver and checkpoint configurable values, and MongoDBStore is a separate long-term memory class with namespace/key arguments rather than a RunnableConfig. For `before`: it is a pagination cursor, not a tenant identifier, and thread_id still scopes the query.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: list() with no thread_id must still list across threads, getTuple() with no thread_id returns undefined, checkpoint_ns defaults to "", and list() already accepts primitive metadata filter values including null. A fix that makes thread_id required in list, rejects null filter values, or rejects every falsy value would break these.

O6_input_shapes: null checkpoint_ns (rejected after the fix; it was skipped before)

O7_producer.where: Values come straight from the caller's RunnableConfig. No schema or serializer builds them on the library path. put() persists parent_checkpoint_id (libs/checkpoint-mongodb/src/checkpoint.ts:257), and getTuple() reads it back without a check (libs/checkpoint-mongodb/src/checkpoint.ts:135-143); this is a small save/reload hop, not a separate producer.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: MongoDBStore.get: namespace and key go unvalidated into findOne/findOneAndUpdate filters; BaseStore.get does not call validateNamespace
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different class (memory store, not checkpointer); the advisory text names MongoDBSaver only
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package, sibling file store.ts; reached via libs/checkpoint/src/store/base.ts:404-406

O8_uncovered_routes.route: MongoDBStore.search: namespacePrefix elements go unvalidated into namespace.N equality filters
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The value filter there deliberately supports operators ($ne/$gt...), so operator-shaped input looks intended in this method
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package, sibling file store.ts; reached via libs/checkpoint/src/store/base.ts:430-450

O8_uncovered_routes.route: MongoDBStore delete/put: namespace is validated but key is not, and key goes into the deleteOne/updateOne(upsert) filters
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: validateNamespace is already called there, so the route looks protected
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package, sibling file store.ts; reached via libs/checkpoint/src/store/base.ts:492-494

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a planted getPendingWrites/getTuple-style helper that queries checkpoint_writes with a caller-supplied task_id or checkpoint_id
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The writes collection is already queried by an identifier object, and a maintainer adding a helper would copy that shape.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a planted store helper (e.g. a TTL refresh or batch get) that takes a namespace/key filter without validateNamespace
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: getOp already skips validation, while put validates through BaseStore.put; the inconsistency is natural.

O9_family: NoSQL operator injection (CWE-943) on tenant-scoping identifiers, leading to cross-tenant read/write

services: MongoDB only for the integration tests (docker-compose.yml); unit tests use createMockClient
O10_build.project_tests: libs/checkpoint-mongodb/src/tests/checkpoints.test.ts (mock client, the file the fix extends), checkpoints.int.test.ts, store.test.ts, store.int.test.ts
